title: Predictable generator via new Random() (java) — review required
description: The java constructor new Random() builds a linear congruential generator seeded from the clock. Its output is predictable from a handful of observed values, so tokens, reset codes and salts drawn from it can be reproduced. Use a cryptographic generator (SecureRandom). This lexical rule flags the constructor.
remediation: Use a cryptographic generator (SecureRandom) for every security value.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the constructor; statistical and simulation uses are reviewed case by case.
